---
title: Why should I deposit data in the Faculty Research Data Collection? 
categories: [Faculty Research Data, Deposit]
order: 0
---

UC Berkeley Library Dataverse is designed to increase the scholarly impact of your research. 

As a UC Berkeley faculty member, you might consider depositing data in the [Faculty Research Data Collection](https://datasets.lib.berkeley.edu/dataverse/oskidata) for any of the following reasons:

- To comply with funder or publisher data sharing requirements
- Ensure reliable access to data
- Increase the discoverability of your research
- Encourage the reuse of your data
- Publish your data with an open license such as [CC0](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en) or [CC BY](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/deed.en)
